data.body: Cluster investigation: this umbrella ticket bundles symptoms from at least 4 distinct root causes. (1) test-merge-to-main*.sh PARSE_ERROR flakes → Track A (see aa4f-13b3 / 42bd-5b9b — sibling-fix omission of cb4a9a7335 in test-merge-to-main-version-bump.sh). (2) test-write-cycle-ledger.sh intermittent failures → DISPROVED as state-file race; that test uses mktemp -d isolation throughout — separate investigation needed. (3) test-gha-scanner SIGPIPE on echo|grep -q at line 95 → Track C, distinct shell idiom defect. (4) test-dso-shim-subdir-dispatch TIMEOUT >120s → Track D, inconclusive (likely scheduler/CPU contention under MAX_PARALLEL=8). Closing this ticket should track only Track A's resolution; sub-issues (2)–(4) should be tracked as separate bugs once their respective fixes land. Confidence: high (split rationale empirically grounded).
